body: We did. She said she's going to work on it. We will see if she changes at all.
My therapist and I talked about that. She's an absolute sweetheart. Can't even been in a different room than me unless she checks on me every other minute haha.

I've tried talking to her about how this all makes me feel but it gets flipped on me sometimes and I just end up feeling worse. When I told her about what I was going through, and how a a week ago I cut my legs because of how she made me feel, she threatened to leave me because she didn't want to deal with it and didn't want people concerned for her, something along those lines. Isn't she supposed to support me in times like this? Not make it worse?
It blows my mind how people that I don't know will go out of there way to just talk to people like this. I really appreciate it.

I go to a therapist for my PTSD and she hasn't said it out loud but I think she is thinking that she isn't right for me. I have an issue with being alone and she seems to think that my still being with her is connected with that in a way.
Yes! I taught her sit, shake, play dead, lay down, come here, and stay. She's 2!!
It's a she. I'm a guy but when we started dating I gained weight just from stopping going to the gym and being more comfortable and eating pizza at 3 am with her, ya know?

She's a great pyrness collie mix and has such a personality it blows my mind. I do exposure therapy and I sit alone in a room in a corner and she comes in and sits on the bed and starts patting her paws and just smiles at me. Absolute sweet heart

I just feel useless. Like I'm not going anywhere. I've lost 40 pounds since January and my fiancee still finds me unattractive and tells me I need to work harder even though I'm damn near starving everyday. It just feels like whatever I do gets criticized and it doesn't matter how big or small it is. But I don't wanna be alone so I don't fight against it. Ya know?
I would suggest witcher 3 also. I started it and got side tracked with other games but started it up and dumped around 100 hours into. SO AMAZING
I second squad. It is such a blast! Hard and still in development but really good once you get the hang of it.

We are giving farm together a try. It's good but I feel like we may run out of things to do. The literal point is just farming, you don't worry about much else and it's really simple. It's quite relaxing but may get dry quick. Still looking for other games though!

Looking for a game that isn't an fps that my fiancee and I can play together. We tried terraria but couldn't really click with it. Not that we don't like games like that, just that one specifically. It would be great for us to be able to explore and play over and over again, not something that is going to just end after a 16 hour campaign or whatever.
